text:
TCP::naglemode
Description
Returns the Nagle mode of a TCP flow.
Syntax
TCP::naglemode
Syntax
TCP
::
naglemode
TCP::naglemode
Return Value
- enabled - disabled - auto
Examples
# Get the TCP Nagle mode of the TCP flow.
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.
"TCP Nagle mode: [TCP::naglemode]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL
